notes.en: Qualified the corrected 1.1.0 package in a real Linux/riscv64 guest with its own declared numerical and diagnostic-plot dependency closure. All nine full-verifier checks passed at the unchanged 1e-8 relative golden tolerance. Three active denial probes excluded unrelated conversion modules while matplotlib/PIL and the unchanged verifier remained usable. The previously missing required matplotlib declaration is now exact and matches the legacy request. Scripts, fixtures, tolerances, tools and top-level capabilities are unchanged. Component CLI qualification is distinct from App UI and physical-device acceptance.
notes.zh-Hans: 修正后的1.1.0包已在真实Linux/riscv64客体中按自身数值与诊断图依赖闭包完成鉴定。完整验证器九项检查全部通过，数值金标准相对容差仍为1e-8；三个实际生效的拒绝探针排除了无关转换模块，同时matplotlib/PIL及原验证器正常运行。此前遗漏的必需matplotlib声明已补齐精确版本并对齐旧式请求。脚本、样本、容差、工具和顶层能力不变。组件CLI鉴定不等于App界面或真机验收。

reviewedPythonPackages.purpose: Array backend of the declared statistical layer (test statistics, assumption screens); identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-numpy (1:2.2.4+ds)

Reference implementations of the supported hypothesis tests and distributions (t/ANOVA/rank/chi2/Fisher/correlation, Shapiro-Wilk, Levene, Tukey HSD); identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-scipy
Tabular input handling for the adapted assumption-check module (DataFrame contract kept from upstream); identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-pandas
OLS regression inference (HC3 robust errors) and exact noncentral-t power/sensitivity analysis; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-statsmodels

Headless Agg diagnostic plot files (Q-Q, histogram, boxplot, scatter/residual) written by the adapted assumption screens and exercised by the golden verifier; identical to Debian 13 guest package python3-matplotlib (3.10.1+dfsg1)
